blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No bettor won the ₱500.61 million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot or the ₱92.85 million Super Lotto 6/49 jackpot on Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. Ultra Lotto 6/58 draw result: 22-14-01-42-09-08 Jackpot prize: ₱500.61 million Super Lotto 6/49 draw result: 34-39-38-18-47-36 Jackpot prize: ₱92.85 million Minor games The PCSO also released the results of the 3D Lotto and 2D Lotto draws held Sunday. Draw schedule Ultra Lotto 6/58 draws are held every Tuesday, Friday and Sunday, while Super Lotto 6/49 draws take place every Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday....
